hunks.baseline: Around noon, a group of men dressed in black appeared atop a low hill.
hunks.sol: Around noon, a group of black-clad men appeared atop a low hill.

hunks.baseline: At a casual wave from the man in front, several dozen black-clad men scattered in every direction.
hunks.sol: At a casual wave from the man in front, several dozen of them scattered across the area to investigate what had happened here and deal with the aftermath.

hunks.baseline: They were here to investigate what had happened—and clean up afterward.
“So we have company already.”
hunks.sol: “So someone got here before us.”

hunks.baseline: The man murmured to himself as he looked down at the scene spread out below the hill.
More precisely, he looked at the vast reed beds extending for a little over ten li in every direction, and the countless birds packed into every open patch between them.
hunks.sol: The man murmured to himself as he looked down the hill at the vast reed beds stretching for more than ten li in every direction—and the countless birds filling the gaps between them with black.

hunks.baseline: Qinghai Lake, only a few days’ travel from here, was also a haven for migratory birds.

hunks.baseline: The trip was arduous. They had to beat their wings without rest across a thousand li. Even so, enormous numbers of them came to Qinghai Lake each year for its clean water and abundant food.
hunks.sol: Qinghai Lake, a few days’ travel from here, was a haven for migratory birds. Reaching it meant beating their wings without rest for a thousand li, but enormous numbers came each year for its clean water and abundant food.

hunks.baseline: A wind carrying a biting chill suddenly swept through the reeds. The migratory birds, busy filling their empty stomachs, shivered.
hunks.sol: A bitterly cold wind swept through the reeds. The birds, busy filling their empty stomachs, shivered.

hunks.baseline: The cold was far too severe to be explained by high elevation alone.
At noon, when the sun should have been at its highest, the sky was already covered in black clouds. Untimely frost had frozen the reed beds solid.
hunks.sol: The cold was far too severe to be explained by the high elevation alone. At noon, when the sun should have been at its highest, black clouds covered the sky. Untimely frost had frozen the reed beds solid.

hunks.baseline: And this sort of inexplicable phenomenon, as though the seasons had forgotten their place, had been going on for more than a day or two.
hunks.sol: And these inexplicable changes, as though the seasons had forgotten their place, had been going on for more than a day or two.

hunks.baseline: The temperature had fallen. A fierce, bitter cold held sway day and night, and the plants, deprived of sufficient sunlight, could no longer show the lushness they once had.
hunks.sol: Temperatures had fallen, and bitter cold raged day and night. Without enough sunlight, the plants had lost their former lushness. Elsewhere, severe drought had struck. It seemed the work of heaven’s whims or some supernatural power—especially when all of it had happened in little more than a year.

hunks.baseline: Elsewhere, a severe drought had struck. It was nothing short of a prank by the heavens, or some supernatural mischief.
All the more so when one considered that these changes had taken place in little more than a year.
As he slowly descended the hill, frost broke beneath his feet. His thoughts grew deeper, like the footprints forming behind him.
hunks.sol: Frost broke beneath his feet as he slowly descended the hill. His thoughts deepened with each footprint he left behind.

hunks.baseline: *This is no mere supernatural mischief. His power borders on that of a heavenly god.*
hunks.sol: *This is no mere supernatural trick. His power borders on that of a heavenly god.*

hunks.baseline: As he thought of his master, the Lord of Heaven, Ma Sanbao felt fear and reverence rise from the depths of his heart.
hunks.sol: Thinking of his master, the Lord of Heaven, Ma Sanbao felt fear and reverence rise from the depths of his heart. Here was a being who could threaten the whole world, change the climate, and even bring the dead back to life.

hunks.baseline: An absolute being who not only threatened the whole world, but could change the climate and even bring the dead back to life.

hunks.sol: Could someone like that truly be called human?

hunks.baseline: Below them lay the dishes that had decorated this sumptuous feast, just as horrifying in stench as they were to look at.

hunks.sol: The countless birds hurtling toward him on beating wings changed course at once and shot high into the sky, obeying the bell’s dull, eerie chime.
